label: q36-35b-ollama-mtp
note: A dedicated `ollama serve` on :8085 over your model store (OLLAMA_NOPRUNE: startup never prunes blobs another server is pulling), so the desktop app's settings and loaded models do not leak in. The tag's own Modelfile is used as shipped: MTP on at depth 2 (draft_num_predict). Explicit tag: on Apple silicon the bare qwen3.6:35b-a3b tag resolves to the MLX NVFP4 build. 32K context and one slot like every engine; flash attention forced on. Every request overrides the tag's presence_penalty 1.5 with 0; thinking is switched off only by reasoning_effort none (Ollama ignores chat_template_kwargs). GGUF weights are mmap'd, so memory shows them as resident mapped files.
